title: Topological-Relativistic-Thermodynamic Learning (TRTL): A Unified Physics-Grounded Machine Learning Framework
description: Permanent open-science research artifact and reproduction software suite for Topological-Relativistic-Thermodynamic Learning (TRTL). Contains mathematical proof scripts, multi-domain benchmark runners, adversarial vulnerability evaluations, 23 publication-grade vector figures, and full-length IEEE TPAMI / Elsevier Pattern Recognition manuscript sources.
